episodes.synopsis: Masane Amaha returns to Tokyo with her daughter, Rihoko, in order to start a new life. Unfortunatelly, a fight between her and some NSWF organisation members who want to separate her from her daughter, Masane is arrested.
episodes.title: The Beginning

episodes.synopsis: After managing to awake the powers of the Witchblade, Masane is captured again and used as a test subject. Meanwhile, Rihoko starts searching for her mother.
episodes.title: Bewilderment

episodes.synopsis: Takayama offers Masane a job, but the only thing on Masane's mind is finding her daughter.
episodes.title: Defiance

episodes.synopsis: The appearance of the Witchblade draws the attention of Furumizu, the leader of the NSWF organisation. Meanwhile, Masane and her daughter start looking for a place to live.
episodes.title: Movement

episodes.synopsis: Tozawa tries to investigate Masane, in order to find out the truth about the Witchblade. Masane refuses to talk, and is challanged to a fight by Shiori, one of the Cloneblades.
episodes.title: Search

episodes.synopsis: Masane is badly injured after her fight with Shiori and is rescued and taken care of by some of Dohji's men. Tozawa has witnessed the fight and decides to find out everything about the Witchblade.
episodes.title: Change

episodes.synopsis: Masane discovers more about Takayama's past. Meanwhile, Shiori goes berserk from over-using the Cloneblade, and decides to attack Masame one more time.
episodes.title: Past

episodes.synopsis: Masane is forced to use the Witchblade in front of Tozawa, when they are attacked by an ex-con.
episodes.title: Reciprocity

episodes.synopsis: Masane and Tozawa learn more about the ex-con's past.
episodes.title: Sadness

episodes.synopsis: Masane is forced to accompany Takayama to a party, where she must confront Wado, one of Takayama's rivals.
episodes.title: Interaction

episodes.synopsis: Maria, a new generation of neo genes, is introduced. Takayama spends a lot of time with Masane due to his hangover, but Masane goes into a panic over her daughter’s illness and the threat of a Cloneblade.
episodes.title: Danger

episodes.synopsis: Tozawa and Takayama try their best to rescue Masane, while NSWF gathers a lot of data. How boldly will Takayama move to get Masane and the Witchblade back?
episodes.title: Prisoner

episodes.synopsis: NSWF’s Child Welfare Division wants to take Rihoko away from Masane to live with her biological mother. Masane and Riko decide to run away, but Nishida sends Nora there to capture the daughter, then Reina interrupts.
episodes.title: Separation

episodes.synopsis: Reina and Rihoko get adjusted to their life as mother and daughter, while a depressed Masane learns something about her past. And Maria receives her cloneblades.
episodes.title: Family

episodes.synopsis: Maria, now armed with her dual cloneblades, seeks out Reina, whom she believes is her mother. However, she doesn’t like what she finds in Reina’s apartment.
episodes.title: Bonds

episodes.synopsis: Masane gets a break from fighting and enjoy a day at a beach resort with Rihoko and their neighbours.
episodes.title: Relaxation

episodes.synopsis: Masane’s bothered a great deal about Rihoko being the next successor of the Witchblade, and Father Furumizu shows he’s got some problems, as Tozawa gets information of his personal history.
episodes.title: Confusion

episodes.synopsis: Investigations to new murders and an anonymous video footage brings trouble to Douji Industries, especially to Takayama.
episodes.title: Turn

episodes.synopsis: Masane forces herself to work with Wado for Riko’s sake, but Riko wants Masane to see Takayama. Meanwhile, Wado still sees Takayama as a threat and sends Ultimateblade Yagi to kill him.
episodes.title: Feelings

episodes.synopsis: Maria takes over the NSWF, meanwhile Masane sets up Takayama and Rihoko to go on a play date, but Takayama is a bundle of nerves and Riko can’t enjoy herself. It looks like Masane will have to join in after all. This incident makes Masane wield the Witchblade in front of her daughter.
episodes.title: Request

episodes.synopsis: Takayama goes to Douji to find data to help Masane’s condition. Meanwhile, Masane tries to remove the witchblade.
episodes.title: Vow

episodes.synopsis: Masane thinks about the future for her daughter and tries to tell her about her impending death at a park. Meanwhile, Maria makes plans to grab the power of the Witchblade and Nishida/Wado send out 3 IU-Weapons to capture the Witchblade.
episodes.title: Telling

episodes.synopsis: Masane spends quality time with Riko, Maria and Asagi head to take the Witchblade, and thousands of malfunctioning I-Weapons converge on Tokyo. Will this be the end of Tokyo?
episodes.title: Chaos

episodes.synopsis: It’s the finale to Witchblade, with Witchblade Masane vs. Dohji and Maria. Rihoko, watching the mother's battle through TV live news, cannot help but rush out to where Masane is.Will Maria get what she wants? Will Masane be able to protect her daughter? Will the Witchblade get what it wants? And that is all the final battle
episodes.title: Light
